title: Fed Decision in September?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's September 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for September 15-16, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their September meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

title: Next Prime Minister of Ethiopia?
description:
General elections are scheduled to be held in Ethiopia on June 1, 2026.

This market will resolve to the next individual who officially assumes the office of Prime Minister of Ethiopia following the 2026 General elections.

To count for resolution, the individual must be officially appointed and sworn in as Prime Minister of Ethiopia. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister takes office by December 31, 2028, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Government of Ethiopia; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Abiy Ahmed’s commanding position in the market stems from his Prosperity Party’s landslide victory in Ethiopia’s June 2026 general election, securing 438 of 501 parliamentary seats and a clear majority that will determine the next prime minister. The outcome followed a campaign marked by limited opposition participation, ongoing regional insurgencies in areas such as Amhara and Tigray, and questions over voter access in conflict zones. As incumbent, Abiy benefits from party control, state resources, and the constitutional process by which parliament selects the prime minister, with his new term expected to begin in early October. While the supermajority makes an immediate change improbable, realistic shifts could arise from sudden internal party fractures, major health developments, or unforeseen escalations in security or economic pressures that erode legislative support.

title: US announces end of Iranian blockade by...?
description:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

eventMetadata.context_description: Persistent geopolitical tensions from the 2026 U.S.-Iran conflict continue to suppress Strait of Hormuz traffic to roughly 3% of normal levels as of early August, with only seven transits recorded in the latest 24-hour period against a pre-crisis average of about 60. Recent early-August incidents and stalled diplomatic progress have reinforced trader caution, while expectations of further U.S.-Iran talks by mid-August represent the next potential catalyst for normalization and any corresponding easing in commodity-market risk premia.
